station_name: Dã Viên (Sông Hương, cầu Dã Viên, Huế)

invalid_ranges.note: Stuck sensor: 1618 consecutive readings of exactly 441.0 mm at normal 10-min cadence while Ngã Ba Sình moved 217-688 mm; ended by a restart (off-grid reading 07:52 UTC). Removed after user review 2026-11-17 (models/da_vien/notes.md, figures/da_vien/data_check.png).
Stuck sensor: 732 consecutive readings of exactly 534.0 mm while Ngã Ba Sình moved 383-572 mm; ended by a restart (off-grid readings 02:26-02:51 UTC). Removed after user review 2026-11-17.

keep.note: 2026-04-11 07:50-08:10 VN dip (-79/-98 mm) follows the same dip at Ngã Ba Sình ~30 min earlier: a real wave travelling NBS -> DV; kept

despike.note: Threshold 85 mm drops exactly the 5 single-reading spikes confirmed by the user on 2026-11-17 (29/03 03:10, 30/06 03:50, 17/08 04:10, 04/09 10:20, 26/09 09:50 VN; deviations +91..+388 mm); the next largest non-kept deviation is -78 mm (28/02, a real NBS->DV wave). figures/da_vien/small_spikes.png

tide.note: Task 28 (2026-11-18): 30-day trailing harmonic fit (10 constituents incl. Q1, MN4, M6), long enough to separate M2/S2 (14.8 d) and K1/O1 (13.7 d); everything else identical to dataset_config_h36_all.json

note: Same as dataset_config_h36_all.json with tide window 30 days (Task 28).

rain_obs.note: east = Bạch Mã 750041 + Đỉnh Bạch Mã 750066; west = Hồng Thái 750062 + Nhâm 750007; plain = Hồ chứa Phú Bài 750014 + VP QLKTCTTL TP Huế 750033 + Thủy điện Bình Điền 750061. Linear check 2026-11-17 (notes Task 4): best single extra group for DV +3 h.

lin_fc.note: In-sample (folds 0) linear +3 h and +6 h forecasts from DV 12 h history + tide_now/tide_d6 + rain_obs + observed NBS history + sea (model "D + biển", Task 10). ECMWF is deliberately NOT a baseline input (it lowered val R2 in the linear check), so both +6 h datasets share the same baseline.

keep.note: 2026-04-11 07:30-07:40 VN dip (-175/-284 mm): Dã Viên dips at about the same time, possibly real; kept after user review 2026-11-16

despike.note: 10-min readings deviating > 150 mm from the centred 2-h median are dropped before the hourly mean (spikes and short plateaus, reviewed in figures/nga_ba_sinh/sensor_spikes*.png on 2026-11-16)

offsets.note: Ngã Ba Sình gauge datum change (see models/nga_ba_sinh sensor_steps): raw step -157 mm while TA/DV rose; NBS minus TA/DV offset shifted by -171..-176 mm and stayed. +172 puts later readings back on the old datum (same value as Task 3/8 in models/da_vien/notes.md).

station_obs.note: Observed Ngã Ba Sình level known at t: NBS(t)-DV(t) and NBS(t)-NBS(t-k), k=1..12.

sea.note: Open-Meteo Marine sea_level_height_msl_previous_day1 (forecast 24 h ahead), grid 16.708/107.708 offshore Thuận An; previous_day1 available from 2025-11-18

fc_ecmwf.note: Same block as Ngã Ba Sình; runs read from ecmwf_single_runs_soil (identical to ecmwf_single_runs on the dataset period, checked 2026-11-17, and continues to 16/11).

wind.note: Same 4 onshore channels as Ngã Ba Sình; file extended to 16/11 (identical to prev_offshore.json on the dataset period, checked 2026-11-17).
